subject: {first_name}, still trading off the group chat?
preview_text: One scan today beats ten opinions tomorrow.
body_paragraphs: I wrote a few days ago about why we built Predictify Crypto — process over noise, setups you can journal, streaks you can keep.

The traders who get value don't stare at Twitter for an hour. They open one chart, run one scan, write the stop, and move on. Do that five days in a row and you build a streak. Streak users aren't luckier — they're consistent.
You already have the app. Take 30 seconds on one chart today.
P.S. One scan today beats ten opinions in the group chat tomorrow.
